EC1: Inability to provide an informed consent
EC2: Evidence of oral distant metastasis [OR] or other malignancies
EC3: The patient has received prior surgery for primary tumor [OR] or lymph node ( [NOT] except for biopsy )
EC5: The patient has previously received anti-tumor biological targeted therapy
EC6: The patient has received chemotherapy [OR] or immunotherapy [AND] for primary tumors
EC7: Prior malignancy within the previous 5 years ([NOT] except for cured skin basal cell carcinoma [OR] or cervical carcinoma in situ)
EC8: With 3-4 grad Allergy [AND] to any drug in the treatment
EC10: Any unstable systematic disease (including active infection [OR], uncontrolled high blood pressure [OR], unstable angina [OR], onset [AND] of angina [OR] within the last 3 months, congestive heart failure [OR], myocardial infarction [OR] within the previous 12 months, severe arrhythmia [OR] needing drug [AND] treatment, liver [OR], kidney [OR] or metabolic disease)
EC12: Chronic diseases requiring immune agents [OR] or hormone therapy
EC14: Drug/alcohol abuse, psychological or spiritual illness that may interfere compliance to the study
EC15: Patients with epilepsy [AND] requiring medications (such as steroids [OR] or antiepileptic drugs)
EC16: The patient has participated in other experimental therapy studies within 30 days
EC17: Researchers believe that the situation is unsuitable for participation in the group
